reason: Requirements explicitly limit comparison to two methods and provide seven labeled inputs. No backend tests exist; execution and grading belong to the parent.
goal: Compare actual final Python boolean-parser outputs on the frozen fixture, save measured conclusions, then complete method explanation and independent review.
baseline: A: lowercase the input without stripping; return JSON true or false for recognized tokens, otherwise "invalid".
constraints: Compare exactly A and B. The requirements explicitly justify two candidates instead of five.
B strips surrounding ASCII whitespace using strip(" \t\n\r\v\f"), then lowercases and validates.
Reuse PROJECT-relative tasks.json without changing inputs, expected outputs or task coverage.
Use Python standard-library functions under identical runtime and execution conditions.
Declare the comparison script only in producer-assets assets.experiments; input_files must contain PROJECT-relative tasks.json.
Keep test_commands empty because there are no existing backend tests.
This planner executes no checks and modifies no files.
No network, package installation, memory writes, commits, deployment or unrelated file additions.
Grade actual function return values from parent-executed artifacts and receipts; preserve failures and uncertainty.
Save measured conclusions before detailed method explanation; completion requires independent review.

criteria.title: Exact final-output accuracy
criteria.acceptance: Parent execution records both methods' actual final outputs for all seven tasks and grades whole JSON values against frozen labels. Report each mean exact-match score and paired difference, including incorrect outputs. Recommend B when its improvement is at least 1/7; equal or worse measured results remain valid research findings.

criteria.title: Fixture and comparison fidelity
criteria.acceptance: The experiment reads unchanged PROJECT-relative tasks.json, invokes both specified Python functions on every input, and exports actual return values with identical task IDs and labels. Candidate implementations differ only by the specified whitespace normalization.

criteria.title: Method explanation
criteria.acceptance: After saving measurements, explain lowercasing, ASCII whitespace stripping and validation, linking the explanation to actual paired outputs and limiting conclusions to the seven supplied tasks.

criteria.title: Independent evidence review
criteria.acceptance: Independent review verifies implementation fidelity, frozen grading, full pair coverage, failures and interpretation against final artifacts and parent receipts. Incomplete review remains explicitly incomplete.

complexity_baseline: Both methods scan strings in O(n) time with O(n) temporary-string space. Complexity is descriptive; latency and memory consumption are not measured in this evaluation.
